plan.title: Order Activity records post-publish participant addition

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event that can be published and then modified.
Use an RFQ stage so the event has a published stage Participants list and Settings menu.
Configure the RFQ stage before selecting its template and data.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the required line item for publication.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Add the initial participant required for publication.
Publish the event so a participant can be added afterward.
Confirm the event reached its real published project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list where post-publish additions are made.
Add another available QA vendor after publication, creating the activity that the case checks.
Confirm the newly added participant is listed on the published stage.
Open the RFQ stage's Order Activity drawer.
Confirm the Order Activity view is open.
Check that the activity view contains text indicating the participant addition.
